title: Radxa Linkr A USB drive-sized IP KVM with USB-C, Ethernet, and WiFi support
summary: Radxa Linkr is a compact, USB flash drive-sized IP KVM that connects to the target through HDMI and USB for video, keyboard, and mouse emulation. The user can control it over USB-C, Ethernet, or WiFi client/access point, even before the OS is booted. The device does not require any specific apps, since all you need is a web browser. The company also highlights support for Tailscale VPN, two-factor authentication, and AI agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes.
